findings: the Phase 3.6 resolver wrote {user: pose, auto: True}; the switch controller honours user only when auto is False, so every performance hand request was replaced by the automatic choice for the base preset (relaxed_standing). The 3.6 review frame labelled 'cupped' shows the relaxed drawings.

the hand bone was at ~80 deg (forearm 64 deg + wrist -16 deg): the camera-facing relaxed drawing turned ~80 deg reads as a presenting palm, not palm up. A flat rotation cannot make a camera-facing palm face up.

the cupped drawings are stored on the wrong side: at rest each is placed ~182 deg from how it was drawn (all other sideways drawings are within 4 deg); the thumb is on the far side, so r2c4 (left_cupped) is a right hand and r4c4 (right_cupped) a left hand. Honoured as stored they are upside down (palm down).

the selection action was relaxed_standing (the base preset), never the gesture; no palm, handedness or rotation constraint existed; pending drawings were shown in review mode (labelled) - correct, but the label named the request, not the drawing actually rendered.
shoulders: the 3.6 shrug used clavicle params 13/15 on a T-pose shoulder line that is already level: the line rose outward (-4 to -6 deg) and the top rose 10-16 px (inflated pads).
